name: Cradle
source:
The AI who follows [url=/c48267]Eve[/url] around. He's responsible for keeping the whole Neosphere functioning.
This robot form is just one of his interfaces.
He's methodical and occasionally annoying, but he always puts Eve first.
Sometimes he breaks down and can't speak.
